description: This file defines a TraceModernizer class responsible for processing and modernizing trace events from different versions of Playwright traces. It includes methods for handling various trace event types, version upgrades, and error handling related to trace version compatibility.

classes.name: TraceVersionError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling trace version incompatibility issues.

classes.name: TraceModernizer
classes.description: Main class responsible for processing, modernizing, and managing trace events across different trace versions.

methods.name: appendTrace
methods.description: Splits the trace string into lines and processes each event.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Returns an array of all ActionEntry objects collected.

methods.name: _pageEntry
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a PageEntry for a given pageId.

methods.name: _appendEvent
methods.description: Parses a JSON line into events and processes each event.

methods.name: _innerAppendEvent
methods.description: Processes individual trace events based on their type, updating context, pages, and snapshots.

methods.name: _processedContextCreatedEvent
methods.description: Checks if a context-created event has been processed.

methods.name: _modernize
methods.description: Converts an event to the latest trace version by applying version-specific transformations.

methods.name: _modernize_0_to_1
methods.description: Transforms trace events from version 0 to version 1.

methods.name: _modernize_1_to_2
methods.description: Transforms trace events from version 1 to version 2.

methods.name: _modernize_2_to_3
methods.description: Transforms trace events from version 2 to version 3.

methods.name: _modernize_3_to_4
methods.description: Transforms trace events from version 3 to version 4.

methods.name: _modernize_event_3_to_4
methods.description: Converts individual events from version 3 to 4, filtering internal or tracing events.

methods.name: _modernize_4_to_5
methods.description: Transforms trace events from version 4 to version 5.

methods.name: _modernize_event_4_to_5
methods.description: Processes individual events from version 4 to 5, handling JSHandle and console message objects.

methods.name: _modernize_5_to_6
methods.description: Transforms trace events from version 5 to version 6, adding log entries.

methods.name: _modernize_6_to_7
methods.description: Transforms trace events from version 6 to version 7, adding context options if missing.

methods.name: _modernize_7_to_8
methods.description: Transforms trace events from version 7 to version 8, updating stepId and title fields.
